Sam (CS): Heads-up: VellumHealth needs a short APAC enable + demo burst next Tue. Ask: ap-southeast-1 pin, IPs 203.0.113.22/32 and 198.51.100.88/32, CORS https://demo.vellumhealth.io, 250 qps window 2026-04-14 14:00-17:00 SGT. Also want a scoped demo key limited to model=v1.3 and log retention=0. @Diego @Maya @Omar can we support?
Asha (VellumHealth): Confirming details. We'd like token expiry 4h after window and only allow generation, no fine-tune calls. Also we'll have ~20 parallel participants using streaming.
Diego (Eng Infra): We can pin tenant=vellum and create route in ap-southeast-1 with fallback to ap-northeast-1. For 250 qps and streaming, reserve 2x g4dn; recommend autoscale min=2 max=3.
Maya (SRE): Reserving 2 nodes now. Autoscale policy set: min=2 max=4, trigger p95>650ms for 3m. Staging ACL updated with the two IPs. Will push prod after signed demo agreement.
Omar (Security): We'll scope token to the two CIDRs, model=v1.3, expires=2026-04-14T21:00:00Z, retention=0. Also require signed demo AUP; recommend disabling request bodies in logs for that token.
Sam (CS): I'll send the AUP and a one-pager security addendum to Asha this afternoon. Asha can you sign by EOD so we can issue the key 24h before demo?
Asha (VellumHealth): Yes, we'll sign and return today. Quick Q: can you isolate the demo traffic to avoid the client's traffic hitting other customers' routes?
Diego (Eng Infra): Yes — tenant pinning + route isolation will keep traffic on the reserved pool. Adding config snippet to staging: 
```json
{"tenant":"vellum","region_pin":"ap-southeast-1","allowlist":["203.0.113.22/32","198.51.100.88/32"],"cors":["https://demo.vellumhealth.io"],"qps_limit":250,"token_constraints":{"model":"v1.3","retention":0}}
```
ops-bot: Capacity reservation created for tenant=vellum: 2 nodes ap-southeast-1 at 4267891238 by Maya (SRE)
Maya (SRE): I'll watch the window; alerts set for cpu>70%, queue latency>200ms, error-rate>0.5%. Ping #eng-sre if anything odd during demo.
Sam (CS): Thanks team. Asha once signed, I'll confirm prod ACL push and hand over the scoped token. Sales noted this account as "engage for renewal" after demo.
